settings.title: French School Holidays
settings.subtitle: School zone, public holidays and sync
settings.sectionLocationDesc: Pick your school vacation zone and, optionally, the public holiday region.
settings.sectionPrefsDesc: Language for vacation/holiday names (official French by default). Homey UI follows the app language.
settings.labelLanguageHelp: Default: official French labels. Switch to English if your Flows/widget run in English.
settings.dataHelp: Official calendars cached on Homey. Nightly recalc ~00:05 (Paris); cache renews at most every 90 days (vacations) / 180 days (holidays).
settings.syncHelp: Re-download calendars immediately, even if the cache is still valid.
settings.schoolZoneHelp: Zone = school academy. Geolocation is only a hint.
settings.suggestError: Could not determine zone from location
